themes.name: Affordable Housing and Rentals
themes.rule: Policies that create, preserve, convert, improve, or make more transparent affordable housing and rental options belong here.

themes.name: Schools and Student Support
themes.rule: Measures concerning school facilities, teaching conditions, classroom learning, school meals, tutoring, or extracurricular education for children belong here.

themes.name: Parks, Gardens, and Trees
themes.rule: Measures that expand or improve parks, community gardens, street-tree canopy, or playground access belong here.

themes.name: Public Transit and Cycling
themes.rule: Measures that improve transit service, transit information or fares, or dedicated cycling infrastructure belong here.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Measures that provide or speed access to physical health care, mental-health care, preventive screening, or in-home elder care belong here.

themes.name: Municipal Service Access
themes.rule: Measures that make city services, procedures, public information, or digital connectivity easier for residents to access belong here.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety
themes.rule: Measures focused on emergency response, crime prevention, street security, or traffic-safety infrastructure belong here.

themes.name: Waste Reduction and Recycling
themes.rule: Measures that reduce disposable waste or expand collection, recycling, or composting systems belong here.

themes.name: Clean Energy and Air Monitoring
themes.rule: Measures that reduce municipal energy emissions or monitor and publish environmental air-quality conditions belong here.

themes.name: Culture and Community Amenities
themes.rule: Measures that provide cultural programming, public art, library access, museum access, festivals, or neighborhood recreation amenities other than parks and playgrounds belong here.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business Support
themes.rule: Measures that support local businesses, workspaces, hiring, business permitting, or workers' career retraining belong here.
